title: SDK: make empty annotation deletion selections a no-op
body:
### Motivation and context

Fixes #11486.

`Task.remove_annotations(ids=[])` and `Job.remove_annotations(ids=[])` currently take the same branch as an omitted selection and issue a full DELETE. A caller that filters existing annotations and finds no matching IDs can therefore erase unrelated annotations.

Distinguish an absent selection (`None`) from an explicitly empty selection. Empty selections return without an annotation request; omitted IDs and `None` keep the documented full-delete behavior. Nonempty selections retain the existing GET/filter/PATCH flow. The method docstring states these three cases.

### How has this been tested?

[Native SDK validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/cvat/actions/runs/43405322890) passed for exact commit `a210f04a4023b157727393a9948133edd4cccee5` on Python 3.11, using the officially generated SDK:

- 28 new cases passed. Against the original source, the same tests produced 12 failures and 16 passing controls.
- All 48 existing SDK mask/attribute unit tests passed.
- Black 25.12.0 and isort 6.1.0 checks passed.

The tests use a local HTTP server and the real generated client, including retrieval of Task/Job response models. They inspect actual annotation GET/PATCH/DELETE requests and resulting isolated state. Cases cover empty lists/tuples/sets/ranges, selective tag/shape/track deletion, repeated or unknown IDs, explicit `None`, omitted IDs and a real empty label-filter result. No running CVAT deployment is needed for this protocol-level regression.

validation.after: 28 new tests and all 48 existing SDK mask/attribute controls passed.
validation.before: Original source with final identical fixtures: 12 failed, 16 passed.
validation.broader: Official SDK generated from the repository schema, real generated HTTP client and isolated localhost protocol server. No actual user tasks or annotations deleted; no full CVAT deployment claimed. Early fixture construction errors were corrected to native HTTP entity retrieval before original/fixed comparison.

independent_review: eval_contributions approved production change and annotation selection semantics; final fixture retrieves native Task/Job models over HTTP, with identical production logic.
deduplication: All 20 pre-existing fork heads are this task or validation/audit branches. Complete seven-entry annotations.py history and actual patches inspected; all-state remove_annotations/empty deletion searches found no core fix. PR #11089 only guards an example caller with `if matched`, leaving the SDK method unchanged; #10961 changes frontend filtering. Original SDK behavior traced to #4813.
